newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's AIDS scandal-hit Green Cross in takeover.
newsitem.headline: Japan's AIDS scandal-hit Green Cross in takeover.

text.p: Scandal-tainted drug maker Green Cross Corp. said Monday it will be taken over by another Japanese pharmaceuticals company in a stock transaction.

The Osaka-based Green Cross has been at the centre of a scandal concerning HIV-tainted blood products after former Green Cross executives were indicted last October on charges of professional negligence.

Green Cross, which will be merged into Yoshitomi Pharmaceutical Industries, a medium-sized drug company, saw a sharp fall in sales after public outrage over the scandal prompted boycotts of its products at many medical institutions.
Green Cross faces compensation payments totalling about 24 billion yen ($196 million) to people who were infected with HIV, the virus that causes AIDS, through the use of its blood products.
The new company will take over responsibility for any compensation to victims of the tainted blood products, officials said.
